content_fields.title: Use Transparent Data Encryption with Enterprise Databases
content_fields.description: Enable transparent data encryption on the database.
content_fields.guidance: The database should encrypt its data files at rest using keys held in a managed key store, with rotation and separation between the key custodian and the database administrator.
content_fields.found: PostgreSQL runs from the stock image with a plain volume; no encryption-at-rest configuration is present.
content_fields.missing: Database server configuration, a key management service and the storage layer the volume lives on.
content_fields.conclusion: Transparent data encryption is configured on the database server and storage platform, not in application source.
content_fields.action: The database administration team should enable encryption at rest with managed keys.
